verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that codes generate without an internet connection or mobile service, and that the app offers a 'Use without an account' option at first launch. The GitHub project confirms it implements RFC 6238 TOTP generation, and a community user notes you can log out of the app to stop cloud sync. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that codes generate offline in practice.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: You can still generate codes without an internet connection or mobile service.
When you first open the app, tap Use without an account.
